title: Five damage still left me alive at one
deckReference: Ali from Cairo — 1994 Red Defense study
era: 1994 casual early-Constructed illustrative table under modern damage rules
matchup: Red defensive study against artifact beatdown
story: I was at three life with Ali from Cairo beside two Mountain s and nothing large enough to block. My opponent sent Juggernaut at me for five combat damage. Ali's replacement effect meant the attack left my life total at one rather than below zero. The attack still dealt damage; Ali had not prevented it. I needed a way to end the game, and I kept Lightning Bolt in hand for the following turn. If Ali disappeared before another hit, my one remaining life would not protect me. It was survival, not invulnerability.
review: Five Juggernaut combat damage against 3-life defender with Ali leads to 1 life, not prevention; creature remains live. Fictional opponents, no tournament attribution.
